scanner: Bug Hunter B4 - Benchmark & Report Bug Hunting
scope: All benchmark_*.json, stress_*.json reports; all .py scripts; route_log.jsonl; route_analysis.json; route_patterns.json

bugs.title: Invalid outcome 'unknown-outcome' on line 1
bugs.description: Line 1 has outcome='unknown-outcome'. Valid outcomes: ['failure', 'partial', 'success']

bugs.title: Route with zero hops and empty route on line 2
bugs.description: Line 2 has hop_count=0 and route=[]. An agent logged a route with nothing traversed.

bugs.title: Empty agent_id on line 5
bugs.description: Line 5 has no agent_id

bugs.title: route_tracker.py 'analyze' crashes on current route_log.jsonl
bugs.description: Running 'python3 storage/coordination/route_tracker.py analyze' crashes with KeyError: 'unknown-outcome' at line 151. This is because line 1 of route_log.jsonl has outcome='unknown-outcome' which is not one of the expected outcome values (success/failure/partial). The analyze function's edge_outcomes defaultdict uses a dict with fixed keys {success, failure, partial} and crashes when encountering an unexpected outcome.

bugs.title: Stored route_analysis.json is stale - does not include current route_log entries
bugs.description: route_analysis.json reports 155 total routes and was generated at 2026-03-12T22:53:33Z, but the current route_log.jsonl only has 4 entries (from the test runs and bug hunting). The stored analysis was generated from a much larger route_log that was later archived. The analysis file was NOT regenerated after archiving to run-002.

bugs.title: beta_analysis.py: hardcoded absolute path
bugs.description: beta_analysis.py line 8 uses hardcoded path: PN_PATH = Path('/home/user/Claude/storage/pointer-network.json'). Other scripts (audit_a1.py, benchmark_c1.py, gamma_benchmark.py) use relative paths via Path(__file__).parent.parent.

bugs.title: beta_analysis.py: hardcoded output path
bugs.description: beta_analysis.py line 292 uses hardcoded output path: '/home/user/Claude/storage/pointer-routes/benchmark_beta_report.json'. Should use a relative path like other scripts.

bugs.title: pathfind_p1.py: all 3 paths are hardcoded absolute
bugs.description: pathfind_p1.py uses 3 hardcoded absolute paths on lines 18-20: NETWORK_PATH, REPORT_PATH, ROUTE_TRACKER. Should use Path(__file__).parent patterns like other scripts.

bugs.title: bugs_b2_scan.py: hardcoded paths for input and output
bugs.description: bugs_b2_scan.py uses hardcoded paths on lines 8 and 382: input '/home/user/Claude/storage/pointer-network.json' and output path.

bugs.title: pathfind_p1.py: uses 'python3' string instead of sys.executable
bugs.description: pathfind_p1.py line 152 uses 'python3' directly in subprocess.run cmd array. If the Python interpreter is at a different path, this will fail. Other scripts correctly use sys.executable.

bugs.title: audit_a1.py: indentation error on line 15
bugs.description: audit_a1.py line 15 has a leading space before 'PN_PATH = BASE / ...' which would cause an IndentationError if the file is run. This appears to be a typo (space before a module-level variable).

bugs.title: Scripts append to route_log.jsonl without backup
bugs.description: All benchmark/stress scripts (s1, s3, s6, s8, c1, gamma) append route log entries via route_tracker.py log. If interrupted mid-run, partial entries could remain. The route_tracker.py itself doesn't have atomic write protection for the JSONL file.

bugs.title: benchmark_c1.py: loads pointer network at module level
bugs.description: benchmark_c1.py loads pointer-network.json at line 18-21 at module scope, before main() is called. If the file doesn't exist, the script fails on import with no helpful error message.

bugs.title: stress_s1.py: loads pointer network at module level
bugs.description: stress_s1.py loads pointer-network.json at module scope. If the file doesn't exist, fails on import with no helpful error.

bugs.title: gamma_benchmark.py: loads pointer network at module level
bugs.description: gamma_benchmark.py loads pointer-network.json at module scope. If the file doesn't exist, fails on import with no helpful error.

bugs.title: stress_s8_simulate.py: loads pointer network at module level
bugs.description: stress_s8_simulate.py loads pointer-network.json at module scope. If the file doesn't exist, fails on import with no helpful error.

bugs.title: stress_s5_analysis.py: has both recursive and iterative DFS; recursive unused
bugs.description: stress_s5_analysis.py defines a recursive dfs() at line 185 for bridge-finding that could stack overflow on large graphs, but then also defines dfs_iterative() at line 199 which is actually used. The recursive version is dead code but confusing.

bugs.title: Gamma vs Beta: network total_edges mismatch (6859 vs 4535)
bugs.description: Gamma reports total_edges=6859 (with unique_edges=6474), Beta reports total_edges=4535 (unique=4535). Both ran on the same pointer-network.json. Gamma counts reason-level edges (shared_tags + explicit_reference + category_affinity = 6859) while Beta counts pointer-level edges.

bugs.title: route_patterns.json has only 1 pattern but route_analysis.json claims 155 routes
bugs.description: route_analysis.json reports 155 total routes across 60 agents and 19 tasks. But route_patterns.json has only 1 pattern (for task 'fail-task'). This means patterns was regenerated after the route_log was mostly cleared but route_analysis was not re-generated from the same data.

bugs.title: route_patterns.json recommends a route with 0% success rate
bugs.description: For task 'fail-task', the recommended_route is 'A -> B -> C' but success_rate is 0%. The patterns system should not recommend routes that always fail.

bugs.title: Unclassified edge count changed: master v1 says 3,910 but v2 and stress master say 3,931
bugs.description: This is expected if run-002 added more edges. The master v1 count (3,910) plus the new edges classified and added should net out. master v2 shows total_edges went from 4,580 to 4,820 (240 new edges), classified went 625->889 (264 newly classified). So unclassified = 4820 - 889 = 3,931 which is correct.

bugs.title: Route with single node (SINGLE-NODE) and zero hops on line 6
bugs.description: Line 6 of route_log.jsonl has route=["SINGLE-NODE"] with hop_count=0. A route with a single node has no traversal - this appears to be a test entry.

bugs.title: Tangential success rate: route_analysis says 0.0% but master report says 66.7%
bugs.description: route_analysis.json strength_effectiveness.tangential.success_rate=0.0 (3 uses). benchmark_master_report.json strength_effectiveness_post_benchmark.tangential.success_rate_pct=66.7 (3 uses). These measure different route populations but the discrepancy is notable.

bugs.title: S3 network traps: S3 report lists 20 traps, stress master says 6
bugs.description: stress_s3_report.json network_traps.traps array has 20 entries (total_traps reports from S3 data), but stress_master_report.json s3_adversarial.network_traps=6. The stress master significantly underreports the trap count found by S3.

bugs.title: Stress master claims S3 cross_domain_hops=1 but this metric is not in S3 report
bugs.description: stress_master_report.json s3_adversarial.cross_domain_hops=1, but this exact field does not appear in stress_s3_report.json. The S3 report has avg_cross_domain_hops in its summary section instead. The stress master value seems fabricated or summarized from the detail data.
